svg.title: How the T-018 weighted-atom lower-bound certificate works
svg.desc: The left panel plots all 1,121 rationally weighted atoms in the side-381/100 container. A grey pin marks every atom site; coloured disk area is proportional to exact weight. Orange identifies the 84 atoms in an exact side-9977/10000 Condition 5 witness centred at 27/50 in both coordinates, whose mass is 4001/4000. The right panel is an explicitly enlarged schematic of the concentric shrink-and-snap step, followed by the exact containment inequality.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:coordinates: left panel mathematical-y-up; right panel explanatory schematic
sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: grey pin marks each site; coloured disk area is proportional to exact weight

svg.text: T-018: where the contradiction comes from
A finite weighted covering certificate turns every possible unit square into a mass budget.
